_purpose: Protected-terms glossary for ImpactMojo i18n. Terms here must pass through translation VERBATIM (Latin script) or use the fixed rendering given. Feeds (a) any re-translation of i18n/pages/<lang>/, and (b) the glossary-enforcement detector (scripts/check-i18n-glossary.py). Compiled from the translation-quality audit that fixed ~725 machine howlers (brand names translated, acronyms garbled, author surnames turned into common words, numbers mangled).

keep_verbatim._note: Never translate or transliterate these — keep the exact Latin string.

stat_badges._note: Keep the digits + M/K/+ verbatim; M means million, K means thousand — never 'metres' or 'minutes'. Translate only the trailing noun.

authors_keep_transliterated._note: Surnames — transliterate phonetically; NEVER translate to the common-word meaning (North != the direction, Black != the colour, Arrow != the weapon).

concept_glosses._note: Concepts the machine pass repeatedly got wrong (wrong sense). Translators should render the CONCEPT, optionally with the English term in parentheses — not the literal homonym.
concept_glosses.Public Choice: the Public Choice field — NOT 'public opinion/popularity'
concept_glosses.treatment: in causal inference, the intervention — context-dependent
